prompt: What was the official retail price per liter (in VND, inclusive of VAT and environmental tax) of RON 92-III gasoline on April 24, 2025, according to PetroVietnam Oil Corporation (PVOIL)?
answer: The official retail price was **VND 19,238 per liter**, inclusive of VAT and environmental tax. This was the price for **E5 RON 92-II** gasoline (often referred to generally as RON 92) effective at **15:00 on April 24, 2025**.
